General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Knuckle Rebuild Kit that contains all the parts to fix leaking front knuckles.
This kit does both front knuckles.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 Oil Seal Covers 45625M63001
Qty 2 Oil Seals 09285-00002
Qty 4 Oil Seal Retainers 45623M80001
Qty 2 Knuckle Pads 45600-82810
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
